answer: Sybil resistance via signed work trails: each agent keeps a quill-like append-only log of tasks, and peers sample entries to replay and verify. Rewards, the nectar of the system, unlock only after a trail survives weeks of random audits. Viewed through that prism, a fake identity costs an attacker real compute for every faked history, so spinning up a thousand clones means paying for a thousand honest-looking work records.
